name: Ryourin Gakuen ~Nerawareta Fuuki Iin Nanami Aoi~
original_name: 陵輪学園～狙われた風紀委員 七海葵～
source:
At Shiritsu Ryourin Gakuen students have autonomy to develop their strengths.
Independence is a major motif. Students control many of the programs.
In such a progressive academy, class president Aoi Nanaumi has many responsibilities. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126671.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在知立菱林学园，学生可以自主发展自己的优势。
独立是一个主要主题。学生控制着许多程序。
在这样一个进步的学园里，葵七海班长肩负着许多责任。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126671.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
